description: This file defines the OppFeed class, which extends the FeedLogicBase class and handles the creation of activity feed entries for Opportunity records within the SuiteCRM system. It constructs feed messages when an opportunity is created or its sales stage changes to 'Closed Won'.

classes.name: OppFeed
classes.description: A class that extends FeedLogicBase to generate activity feed entries specific to Opportunities, particularly on creation or sales stage change to 'Closed Won'.

methods.name: pushFeed
methods.description: Generates a feed message when an Opportunity is created or its sales stage is changed to 'Closed Won' and pushes it to the activity feed via SugarFeed::pushFeed2.
